package handler

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	db "example.com/slg-practice/db"
	player "example.com/slg-practice/game/entities/player"
	tileentity "example.com/slg-practice/game/entities/tile"
	sender "example.com/slg-practice/game/handler/syncsender"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/clock"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type slgGetter map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity

func (g slgGetter) Get(_ context.Context, id int64, _ entity.EntityCategory) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	if value := g[id]; value != nil {
		return value, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown entity %d", id)
}
func (g slgGetter) GetMany(ctx context.Context, ids []int64, cats []entity.EntityCategory) ([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	values := make([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		value, err := g.Get(ctx, id, cats[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		values[i] = value
	}
	return values, nil
}

// 正式 Nest 提交路径的替身；本场景不声称 WAL fsync / Mongo 验收，真实存储另跑标准生成工程脚本。
type slgCommitter struct{}

func (slgCommitter) Commit(context.Context, dataengine.CommitRecord) error { return nil }

type slgFixture struct {
	now     time.Time
	subject *player.Player
	getter  slgGetter
	engine  *nest.NestMgr
}

func newSLGFixture(t *testing.T) *slgFixture {
	t.Helper()
	f := &slgFixture{now: time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0), getter: slgGetter{}}
	// 定时器 Tick 按本条消息冻结的业务时间触发（fctx 取自进程业务时钟），驱动的到期查询用 SetClock：两处停在同一时刻。
	player.TimerDriver.SetClock(func() time.Time { return f.now })
	clock.SetSource(func() time.Time { return f.now })
	t.Cleanup(func() { clock.SetSource(nil) })
	player.RegisterEntity()
	RegisterSlgTasksNestHandlers()
	RegisterTickPlayerTimerGenNestHandlers()
	id, err := entity.BuildEntityID(4242, player.EntityKindPlayer)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	built, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Kind: player.EntityKindPlayer})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.subject = built.(*player.Player)
	f.getter[id] = f.subject
	f.engine = nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithGetter(f.getter), nest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(slgCommitter{}), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 1, QueueCap: 32}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}))
	if err := f.engine.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fund := nest.NewHandlerName("slg_fund_" + t.Name())
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(fund, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		es[0].(*player.Player).Dao().SetGold(50)
		return nil, nil
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	if _, err := f.engine.Request(context.Background(), fund, f.subject.ID(), nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := player.TimerDriver.Bind(f.engine, func(id int64) entity.IThreadSafeEntity { return f.getter[id] }); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = f.engine.Shutdown(context.Background())
		f.subject.TimerComp().OnDestroy(entity.DestroyReasonMemoryUnload)
	})
	return f
}

func (f *slgFixture) tick(t *testing.T, after time.Duration) {
	t.Helper()
	f.now = f.now.Add(after)
	if _, err := sender.NewTickPlayerTimerGenSender(f.engine).Sync_TickPlayerTimer(context.Background(), f.subject.ID()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestSLGConstructionMarchAndReplay(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSLGFixture(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	s := sender.NewSlgTasksSender(f.engine)
	id, err := s.Sync_SLGStart(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1, 501)
	if err != nil || id == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("start %d: %v", id, err)
	}
	replay, err := s.Sync_SLGStart(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1, 501)
	if err != nil || replay != id || f.subject.Dao().GetGold() != 40 {
		t.Fatalf("replay id=%d gold=%d err=%v", replay, f.subject.Dao().GetGold(), err)
	}
	f.tick(t, 2*time.Second)
	if f.subject.Dao().GetBuildingLevel() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("construction did not complete")
	}
	if _, ok := player.TimerDriver.DueOf(f.subject); !ok {
		t.Fatal("march persisted but disappeared from driver")
	}
	f.tick(t, player.MarchDuration)
	if f.subject.Dao().GetMarches() != 1 || f.subject.Dao().GetArrivedX() != 501 {
		t.Fatal("march did not arrive exactly once")
	}
	f.tick(t, time.Minute)
	if f.subject.Dao().GetMarches() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("march repeated")
	}
	if _, err := s.Sync_SLGStart(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1, 501); err != nil || f.subject.Dao().GetGold() != 40 {
		t.Fatal("completed construction replay charged again")
	}
}

func TestSLGCancelRefundAndRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSLGFixture(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	s := sender.NewSlgTasksSender(f.engine)
	if _, err := s.Sync_SLGStart(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 2, 501); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("out of order level accepted")
	}
	id, err := s.Sync_SLGStart(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1, 501)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		canceled, err := s.Sync_SLGCancel(ctx, f.subject.ID(), id)
		if err != nil || canceled != (i == 0) {
			t.Fatalf("cancel %d: %v %v", i, canceled, err)
		}
	}
	f.tick(t, time.Hour)
	if f.subject.Dao().GetGold() != 50 || f.subject.Dao().GetBuildingLevel() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("refund duplicated or canceled construction fired")
	}
}

func TestSLGFailureRollsBackResourcesAndDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSLGFixture(t)
	name := nest.NewHandlerName("slg_reject_after_arm")
	refused := errors.New("injected business rejection")
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(name, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		_, err := handlerSLGStart(es[0].(ISLGEntity), 1, 501)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, refused
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	if _, err := f.engine.Request(context.Background(), name, f.subject.ID(), nil); !errors.Is(err, refused) {
		t.Fatalf("rejection=%v", err)
	}
	if f.subject.Dao().GetGold() != 50 || f.subject.Dao().TimersLen() != 0 || f.subject.Dao().GetPendingBuild() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("rollback left a charge or timer")
	}
	if _, ok := player.TimerDriver.DueOf(f.subject); ok {
		t.Fatal("rollback published a deadline")
	}
}

func TestSLGOfflineIncomeIsBusinessBounded(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSLGFixture(t)
	arm := nest.NewHandlerName("slg_income")
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(arm, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		es[0].(*player.Player).TimerComp().NewTimer(time.Minute, player.TimerIncome, 0, 0, nil)
		return nil, nil
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	if _, err := f.engine.Request(context.Background(), arm, f.subject.ID(), nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw := f.subject.Dao().Marshal()
	f.subject.TimerComp().OnDestroy(entity.DestroyReasonMemoryUnload)
	f.subject.SetRemoved()
	f.now = f.now.Add(10*time.Minute + 30*time.Second)
	copy := db.NewPlayerDao()
	if err := copy.Unmarshal(raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	built, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: false, Id: f.subject.ID(), Kind: player.EntityKindPlayer, Dao: map[string]entity.DaoInterface{"player": copy}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.subject = built.(*player.Player)
	f.getter[f.subject.ID()] = f.subject
	f.tick(t, 0)
	if gold := f.subject.Dao().GetGold(); gold != 60 {
		t.Fatalf("offline income gold=%d, want 60 (business cap 10)", gold)
	}
	f.tick(t, 0)
	if f.subject.Dao().GetGold() != 60 {
		t.Fatal("offline income paid twice")
	}
	f.tick(t, time.Minute)
	if f.subject.Dao().GetGold() != 61 {
		t.Fatal("periodic income did not resume")
	}
}

func TestSLGTwoPlayersCompeteForOneTile(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSLGFixture(t)
	tileentity.RegisterEntity()
	playerID, err := entity.BuildEntityID(4243, player.EntityKindPlayer)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	built, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: playerID, Kind: player.EntityKindPlayer})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	other := built.(*player.Player)
	t.Cleanup(func() { other.TimerComp().OnDestroy(entity.DestroyReasonMemoryUnload) })
	tileID, err := entity.BuildEntityID(1, tileentity.EntityKindTile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ground, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: tileID, Kind: tileentity.EntityKindTile})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.getter[playerID] = other
	f.getter[tileID] = ground
	if _, err := f.engine.Request(context.Background(), nest.NewHandlerName("slg_fund_"+t.Name()), playerID, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ids := []int64{f.subject.ID(), playerID}
	results := make([]bool, 2)
	errs := make([]error, 2)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for i := range ids {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			results[i], errs[i] = sender.NewSlgTasksSender(f.engine).MultiSync_SLGClaimTile(context.Background(), ids[i], tileID)
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	if errs[0] != nil || errs[1] != nil || results[0] == results[1] {
		t.Fatalf("competition results=%v errors=%v", results, errs)
	}
	winner := 0
	if results[1] {
		winner = 1
	}
	if ground.(*tileentity.Tile).Dao().GetOwnerID() != ids[winner] {
		t.Fatal("ownership and transaction winner disagree")
	}
	if f.subject.Dao().GetGold()+other.Dao().GetGold() != 99 {
		t.Fatal("payment was duplicated or lost")
	}
	if won, err := sender.NewSlgTasksSender(f.engine).MultiSync_SLGClaimTile(context.Background(), ids[winner], tileID); err != nil || !won {
		t.Fatalf("winner replay=%v %v", won, err)
	}
	if f.subject.Dao().GetGold()+other.Dao().GetGold() != 99 {
		t.Fatal("ownership replay paid again")
	}
}

func TestSLGResearchAndConstructionUseIndependentQueues(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSLGFixture(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	s := sender.NewSlgTasksSender(f.engine)
	if _, err := s.Sync_SLGStart(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1, 501); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	id, err := s.Sync_SLGResearch(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1)
	if err != nil || id == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("research id=%d err=%v", id, err)
	}
	if replay, err := s.Sync_SLGResearch(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1); err != nil || replay != id {
		t.Fatalf("research replay %d %v", replay, err)
	}
	if f.subject.Dao().GetGold() != 35 {
		t.Fatal("parallel queues or replay charged incorrectly")
	}
	f.tick(t, 2*time.Second)
	if f.subject.Dao().GetBuildingLevel() != 1 || f.subject.Dao().GetResearchLevel() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("research completed at construction deadline")
	}
	f.tick(t, time.Second)
	if f.subject.Dao().GetResearchLevel() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("research did not complete independently")
	}
	if _, err := s.Sync_SLGResearch(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1); err != nil || f.subject.Dao().GetGold() != 35 {
		t.Fatal("completed research replay charged again")
	}
}
